sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The cait sith is a mythological animal of Scotland. This black spectral creature of the Highlands had an uncertain species, probably feline. It grew so large that people sometimes mistook it for a Black Dog. Its name means fairy cat, which suggests membership of the fairy race. Some reports called it a shape-shifting witch or the witch's familiar.

okr.objective: The cait sith is a huge spectral cat of the Scottish Highlands.
